non_blocking_risks: Retry aperture is scoped strictly to insert-batch execution; a 40001 surfaced by contended updates or replay-idempotency writes during the same campaign would still terminate the run, even though CockroachDB serializable contention could plausibly produce it at concurrency 250. This is consistent with the preserved diagnosis but means the canary remains brittle to that class.
Fixed 250 ms backoff with no jitter is acceptable for a local disposable node but is not a defensible production retry policy; conclusions must remain local-canary only.

Retry boundary is per-batch with a global aggregate counter, but the contract does not specify an aggregate retry ceiling. Three-per-batch across 5,000 vectors could in principle permit a large aggregate count without terminal failure; bounded by the immutable-batch and exact-SQLSTATE constraints, but worth noting.
evidence_required: Canonical local canary result receipt post-replacement attempt, including per-stage and aggregate retry counts.
Teardown receipt proving both loopback ports closed and generated root identity validated and deleted.
Failure receipt preserving exact SQLSTATE and output hash if any batch terminates.
Confirmation that no product code, schema, generated row, workload, concurrency setting, latency threshold, evidence contract, or teardown behavior differs from the frozen canary contract.
